$comment: Registry v2 of the stackable text effects (docs/text-motion-references.md). Single source of truth for
backend/app/text_motion.py (Python -> libass, the MP4) and src/textMotion.ts (the live preview): both engines
interpret the same data with the same maths, so preview and render agree, and effects stack because channels
are COMPOSED, never overwritten. Projects store effect ids (never labels): never change an id.
phase     in | hold | out                    lane in the editor: Enter / While shown / Exit
unit      char | word | line | text          what one animated piece is (users may override per layer)
duration  in/out: seconds the whole layer takes (all units); hold: loop period, or for loop 'once' the travel
time (omitted = the whole text window minus the steady tail)
stagger   0..1 cascade: 0 = all units together, 1 = strictly one after another. Loops: fraction of the
period between neighbouring units
order     forward | reverse | center | edges | random
loop      hold only: loop | pingpong | once
tracks    channel -> keyframes [[u, value, easing?], ...] over the unit's local time u in [0,1], or a generator
{sine | noise | flicker | bounce}; values: number | '#rrggbb' | 'base' (colour below this layer) |
'$param' | {'rand':[a,b]} (per unit, deterministic) | colour tokens bgA, bgB, contrastA, contrastB
channels  multiply: opacity, scale, sx, sy, fill, squash | add: x, y (em), vx, vy (fraction of the frame),
rz (degrees, clockwise), rx, ry (degrees), skew, blur (em), spacing (em), line (em), gather (0..1 pull to
the text centre) | max: glow, depth, rgb, orbit | colour: folded in stack order | clip: [l,t,r,b] of the
unit box (+clipPad em), intersected, only while the layer runs | path: the motion path editor's path
copies    extra drawn copies: glow | trail | extrude | mirror | rgb | shadow | box (box: alpha = opacity,
height em, valign center|cap|baseline, offsetY em, pad [x,y] em, clip keys, anchor left, own tracks)
content   text rewriting, at most ONE per phase: scramble (mode during|pending|after) | flap | count | countdown
caret     typing caret following the last visible letter
colourWipe  colour swept across each unit while it runs: {from, to, dir}
bg        needs a text frame with a colour change A->B: follow (text colour changes with the transition, same
shape and timing), arrive / leave (text visible only where colour B has / has not arrived yet)
sync      'bg': time the layer to the frame's colour transition instead of the text window
legacy    the v1 label (registry/text-effects.json) this entry replaces, for migrating saved projects

effects.label: Breathe (weight)

effects.label: Hand-drawn boil
effects.notes: Letters wobble a little, like a hand-drawn animation.

effects.label: Follow background
effects.source: New · the text colour changes with the frame's colour transition (same shape and timing)

effects.notes: Text frames with a colour change only.

effects.label: Pulse on colour change
effects.source: New · one pulse timed to the frame's colour transition
effects.notes: Text frames with a colour change; elsewhere it pulses once over the whole text.

effects.label: Fold away · words

effects.label: Write off
effects.source: Reverse of Write on (erased left to right)

effects.label: Leave with background
effects.source: New · the text disappears exactly where colour B arrives (same shape and timing as the frame transition)
effects.notes: Text frames with a colour change only.
